How it Works

No maze, no five-step checkout. Three steps and you're in the chair.

01

Book in 20 seconds

Pick a service, a day, and a time below. One tap sends it to the shop — we text back to confirm your chair.

02

Show up, sit down

Your chair is held for your slot. Running late? Reply to the confirmation text and we'll do our best to slide you in.

03

Walk out sharp

Finished with a style check in the mirror before you pay. If a line isn't clean, we fix it on the spot — free.
